reviews.reviewerId: scene-closure execution owner (Claude Opus 5 main session, openclinxr-c2)
reviews.observations: REJECTED THIS CARD TWICE BEFORE ACCEPTING IT, both times on a measurement I took myself rather than on the implementer report. First rejection: the card delivered production-boundary tests and no browser measurement, which clause 5 requires as well; recorded as failed treatment production-boundary-tests-without-browser-measurement. Second rejection: the browser capture reported foot-slide FAILING and attributed it to the swing foot inside the 0.06 m contact band at 60 Hz. Measured from that capture own 330 samples, the median frame interval is 248 ms, so it samples at 4.03 Hz and not 60. At that cadence a 0.658 m/s foot covers 0.163 m between samples, 33x the 0.005 m allowance, and the worst recorded step is 0.32907 m over a 10 ms interval, 32.9 m/s, which is a discontinuity and not a foot. Restricting to frames where both samples sit within 0.015 m of the floor still left 0.19541 m on the right toe with 91 percent of it on frames longer than 25 ms, so tightening the band rescues nothing. SC-00 own maxFrameGapRatio of 2 already refused that stream at 2.21 and the grader never asked it, which is a metric grading data its own sufficiency gate would reject. The implementer reproduced every number, retracted the diagnosis in place rather than deleting it, and built the gate: measureCadence runs before any contact verdict and a failing stream yields not_gradeable carrying its numbers, with verify.ts refusing a report that records either outcome over a stream its cadence gate rejects. Raising the cadence reached 7.94 Hz against about 132 Hz needed, so foot-slide closes not_gradeable in browser on a stated measured limit. THIRD ROUND, and the one that mattered most: I measured the penetration DISTRIBUTION rather than the reported headline and found 238 of 782 toe readings below the floor plane, 150 deeper than the allowance, and 137 of them in the ARRIVED phase, so the physician stood at the bedside with his toes about 14 mm underground for the whole settled period. The implementer traced it to one term, animation-loop.ts standing branch writing slot.baseY plus breathing times 0.018, a rigid translation of the whole actor with nothing holding its feet, identified by an arrived-phase sinusoid of 0.0340 m peak to peak at 5.4 s against the 5.464 s period of sin(t times 1.15). Removing it lifts nothing because sin has zero mean, and breathing survives in the scale term whose group origin is at the feet. It also built and WITHDREW two stance-lock treatments with measurements rather than arguing them, and found that the clause asserting floor penetration could never have failed because the harness applied none of the loop idle terms; control 9 now passes the removed 0.018 m back in. Owner re-measure of the final capture, independently: 13 of 746 toe readings below the plane, 0 deeper than the allowance, all 13 inside the walk, deepest 0.00179 m against 0.01430 m before. Reran every doneWhen at the integrated head: 12, 8 and 1 tests, assert-contract-live 1 contract live, verifier suite 35, and 622 across every touched package and landed card; typecheck 0 on both configs, architecture 8 of 8, knip clean. Two owner repairs: three package barrel imports narrowed to declaring modules after they took typecheck:relaxed from 0 to 19, and one pre-existing unused import dropped from animation-loop.ts, linted for the first time because the file was finally staged. The changed-file audit lists all 30 files the card touched across its four commits rather than only the last round; docs/openclinxr/doc-authority-registry-2026-05-27.json is the one file in the diff that is NOT the card, being my own registration of sc-05.md in a protected registry. ACCEPTED WITH TWO DECLARED OPEN ITEMS, neither hidden and neither admitted by moving a threshold: foot-slide is not gradeable in browser at 7.94 Hz against 132 Hz needed, and the terminal settle turn fails foot-slide offline because no turn-in-place take exists in the cleared clip set.

unprovenClinical: qualified clinical review of the bedside side, the 0.75 m standoff, the working position and the gait is PENDING. Nothing here establishes clinical validity, exam equivalence, or that a physician should approach this patient from this side at this distance. The anthropometric figures the clearance and monitor checks lean on (0.3 m footprint, 1.8 m standing height, 1.55 m eye height) are external adult floors, not a validated standard for any procedure.
unprovenHeadset: no worn-headset run; every observation is a node/vitest process on M1 Max
unprovenPublication: no Pages push, no public deployment, no media, no rendered frame
unresolvedDefects: FOOT-SLIDE IS not_gradeable IN A BROWSER ON THIS MACHINE. The retained capture (store/sc-05/ui-xr-bedside-approach-inspection.json) samples at a 125 ms median interval (8.00 Hz) with a 2.82x max-over-median against SC-00's frozen maxFrameGapRatio of 2, and a foot covers 0.0822 m between samples, 16x the 0.005 m per-frame allowance; identifying a contact window needs about 132 Hz. A 480x320 viewport and Chromium's frame-cap flags took the run from 4.03 Hz to 8.00 and no further; the remaining cost is four skinned humanoids and a compiled room GLB through SwiftShader. CORRECTED 2026-09-09: an earlier revision of this entry read "a 126 ms median interval (7.94 Hz) with a 4.36 max/median", which are the round-3 capture's numbers and not this report's; the values above are read off the retained artifact's own cadence block. Separately, a still earlier revision graded the browser foot-slide as FAILING from an assumed 60 Hz that was never measured; that verdict was wrong in the same way a passing one would have been, and measureCadence now refuses either. A08 stays OPEN on the browser half, on that number.

RETRACTED, NOT OPEN: the browser floor-penetration FAILURE. An earlier revision of this entry read "THE BROWSER RUN FAILS floor-penetration at 0.01430 m against 0.005 m." That was measured before 0e2bbecd removed the rigid +/-18 mm breathing translation from a standing body's root. The retained capture measures deepestFloorPenetrationMeters = 0.00179 m against the 0.005 m cap, and 13 sub-floor toe readings against the pre-fix 238, all inside the walk. The metric PASSES and is recorded here as withdrawn rather than deleted, because the previous revision asserted a failure that no longer exists.

NO VIDEO. The browser evidence is one PNG at the stopped pose plus 373 frames of measured telemetry; acceptance-v2.md's uninterrupted activation-to-arrival-plus-stop recording is SC-07's. CORRECTED 2026-09-09: an earlier revision said "391 frames"; the retained artifact's rawEvidence.samples is 373 and its frameCount is 373.

RETRACTED, NOT OPEN: "NO BROWSER MEASUREMENT". An earlier revision of this entry read "No dev server ran, no frame was rendered and no capture was taken" and stated that every number in this report was offline geometry through the shipped consumers in node. That was true of round 1 only. A browser capture DID run: chromium against the shipped dev server, 373 skeleton samples, drive case_owned_bedside_approach with window.__openClinXrPedsDrive absent, retained as store/sc-05/ui-xr-bedside-approach-inspection.json and graded in obs-21. Leaving the round-1 text in place made this list contradict its own neighbours and the retained artifact. What remains open on the browser half is foot-slide only, on the cadence entry above; arrival, settled heading, stop duration, stopped root travel and floor penetration are all measured and passing.

THE BOUND WALK CLIP TRAVELS BACKWARDS. Measured on the shipped physician: the rig faces +Z (its toes sit 0.126 m in +Z of the ankle at rest and its left foot at +X) while every stance window of openclinxr_retarget_walk_formal_cc0 advances the body along body -Z. The runtime compensates by aligning the slot to the clip's MEASURED travel direction, which makes the foot plant correct and leaves the physician's face pointing back down the route while he walks. The fix is a rebind of the asset, which is outside this card's write roots.

THE TERMINAL TURN DRAGS A PLANTED FOOT. There is no turn-in-place take in the shipped clip set, so the settle rotates the actor with a foot on the floor. Graded separately, that interval's foot-slide TOTAL is over its per-window allowance; its worst single frame is inside the 0.005 m cap, so it is a slow drag rather than a visible pop. The walk and stopped intervals both pass. The whole-run grade therefore fails foot-slide, and that is reported rather than split away.

THE ACCEPTANCE OBSERVATION STILL HAS NO TRANSPORT. SC-03 recorded it and it is unchanged: the runtime's support acceptance gates this approach locally, and packages/openclinxr/rest still carries no requirement-observation endpoint. Both are outside this card's frozen write roots.

THE SKELETON IS DECODED, NOT GLTFLoader-LOADED. three's GLTFLoader reaches `self` and cannot parse these bytes in node, so the joint tracks come from SC-00's decoder and are attached through the loader's own child-transform contract, which is read from generated-loaders.ts and asserted.
